title: Kaldereta Beef Tacos
description: A Mexican twist on the classic Filipino dish, featuring tender beef in a rich tomato sauce served in crispy tacos.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium-high heat.
Add beef to the skillet and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add garlic and cumin to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
Add Kaldereta sauce to the skillet and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes or until the beef is tender.
Warm tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble tacos by spooning beef mixture onto a tortilla and topping with cheese, sour cream, and cilantro if desired.
